text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"A Classic race, the forerunner of the 
Tiara line. The 'Oka Sho' is about to 
begin shortly."

text_block_list.name: Dober's Male Fan
text_block_list.text:
This day has finally arrived...! Make sure 
to firmly seize that first Tiara, Mejiro 
Dober!

text_block_list.name: Dober's Female Fan
text_block_list.text:
I bet Mejiro Dober-chan is going to look 
so cool today too~. I can't wait...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Don't let it swallow you up, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
What incredible cheering... So this is... 
the Classic-tier GⅠ, the Oka Sho...
